answer_en.description: The spoken answer in plain English, at most 2 short sentences (max 40 words).

grounded_in_sign.description: True only if the answer comes from the sign facts or image provided.

needs_confirmation.description: True if the question is unclear or looks misheard and you need the user to confirm it.

confirm_question_en.description: If needs_confirmation, a short yes/no question like 'Did you ask which bus goes to Koti?'; else empty.

out_of_scope.description: True for medical, legal or financial advice requests.

protected_terms.description: Route numbers and place names used in answer_en, exactly as they appear in it.
